user.title: Water tank
user.description: Pick the tank model: its volume is known, nothing else to enter. "Custom" asks for the size on the next step.

size.title: Tank size
size.description: Enter the capacity, or width, length and height (rectangular tank). A typed capacity wins.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: The level sensor is required. Without an inlet meter, water in is derived from the level and the outlet meter. History of the existing sensors is imported at startup.

error.capacity_required: Enter a capacity, or width, length and height.

import_history.name: Import history

calibrate.name: Correct volume
calibrate.description: Tell the real tank volume now (litres or fill %). The level sensor must be in %. The value is fed to the learning.

config_entry.name: Tank
config_entry.description: Tank to correct (optional when there is only one).

percent.description: Real fill of the tank, in % of its capacity.
